description: Charge parity of the Markov-trace bond-multiplicativity defect at n=4. The recorded cross term z(z^2-hz-1) is on BARE generators; this dresses the letters as sigma_i + d_i*I with the canonical bond dressings and splits the defect under the charge conjugation d -> -h-d. The verdict is REPORTED, not asserted. Scope (a): n=4 with three bonds, not a nucleus; the production atom word is sequential so no production number moves.

builds_on.why: qou-brng closes the Ocneanu trace family (rank bound), the magnitude (cyclic_trace_kills_iterCommTower), mu-bar_123 (channel-blind) and the whole linking-data class (lk IS I_3, both channels at I_3 = 0). Its closure note leaves open 'an invariant reading the braid word beyond its linking data', and the multiplicativity defect is such an object.

mirror_map: d -> -h - d  (p<->n on each bond; exchanges d_pp=0 and d_nn=-h)

verdict.odd_part: Mul(Pow(Symbol('q', positive=True), Integer(-1)), Pow(Add(Pow(Symbol('q', positive=True), Integer(4)), Mul(Integer(2), Pow(Symbol('q', positive=True), Integer(2))), Integer(1)), Integer(-1)), Add(Mul(Integer(-1), Symbol('d2'), Pow(Symbol('q', positive=True), Integer(5))), Mul(Integer(-1), Symbol('d2'), Pow(Symbol('q', positive=True), Integer(3))), Mul(Integer(-1), Symbol('d2'), Symbol('q', positive=True)), Mul(Integer(-1), Rational(1, 2), Pow(Symbol('q', positive=True), Integer(6))), Rational(1, 2)))

factorisation.consequence: The cross term's entire charge dependence is one bond factor times a charge-blind scalar, so its mirror odd/even RATIO equals the bond factor's own. The interleaved word class changes the MAGNITUDE of the bond channel (extra binding, which is what qou-kru4 wants it for) and provably cannot change its CHARGE PARITY.

scope: (a) scope-limited: n=4, three bonds, exact and symbolic. Not a nucleus. Does NOT claim the production word is interleaved -- it is sequential (qou-5vhf is which word class a nucleus is).

assertions.name: REP_hecke_relation_holds
assertions.detail: sigma^2 = h sigma + 1 in the representation -- if this fails the rep is not Hecke.

assertions.name: REP_braid_relation_holds
assertions.detail: sigma0 sigma1 sigma0 = sigma1 sigma0 sigma1 in the representation.

assertions.name: CONTROL_bare_limit_reproduces_the_recorded_cross_term
assertions.detail: Delta|_(d=0) = -q**3*(q**2 - q + 1)*(q**2 + q + 1)/(q**2 + 1)**3; recorded (qou-kru4 audit) = -q^3(q^2-q+1)(q^2+q+1)/(q^2+1)^3.  If this fails, the dressing is wrong and nothing else in this probe means anything.

assertions.name: MIRROR_is_an_involution
assertions.detail: M(M(d)) = d, so the even/odd split below is well defined.

assertions.name: MIRROR_exchanges_the_pp_and_nn_dressings
assertions.detail: M(d_pp = 0) = -h = d_nn and M(d_nn) = d_pp.  This is what makes M the charge conjugation rather than an arbitrary affine map.

assertions.name: FACTORISATION_Delta_eq_lastBondFactor_times_MarkovDefect
assertions.detail: Delta = (z + d2)(z^2 - hz - 1) EXACTLY.  The convention-D Markov defect z^2-hz-1 = -(q**2 - q + 1)*(q**2 + q + 1)/(q**2 + 1)**2 is charge-BLIND, so the entire charge dependence of the cross term is the single factor f2.

assertions.name: CHARGE_DEPENDENCE_IS_ONLY_THROUGH_THE_PEELED_BOND
assertions.detail: d0 present in Delta: False;  d1 present: False.  The two INTERLEAVED bonds drop out entirely; only d2 -- the bond on the generator that is Markov-peeled -- survives.  So the object that reads the word beyond its linking data does not read the CHARGES of the letters it interleaves.

assertions.name: PARITY_RATIO_IS_IDENTICAL_TO_THE_BOND_FACTOR_ITSELF
assertions.detail: Delta_odd/Delta_even == f2_odd/f2_even identically.  Multiplying by a charge-blind scalar cannot move an odd/even ratio, so the cross term inherits the bond channel's isospin parity structure VERBATIM -- the same structure QOU.MassTheory.BondChannelTzParity proves cannot be even at any q > 1.
